findings.title: BuildIndex no longer prevents duplicate builds for same key
findings.body: BuildIndex in bleve.go removed the coarse lock that serialized whole builds and now only locks around the final map insert. getOrCreateIndex does check-then-build (GetIndex returns nil, then BuildIndex), so two concurrent Search/init workers for the same NamespacedResource can both enter BuildIndex. For file-backed indexes both will call bleve.New on the same directory, one will fail or corrupt, and metrics IndexTenants is incremented twice. One overwrites the other in the cache, leaking the loser. Need per-key singleflight/mutex.

findings.title: TotalDocs reads cache map without lock
findings.body: TotalDocs in bleve.go iterates b.cache without holding cacheMu, while GetIndex takes RLock and BuildIndex takes Lock for writes. If a late index is built via Search/getOrCreateIndex concurrent with TotalDocs (called during init logging), this is a concurrent map read/write data race and can panic. Hold RLock in TotalDocs.

findings.title: init errgroup closure races on shared err and counter
findings.body: searchSupport.init in search.go launches one goroutine per stat that does totalBatchesIndexed++ and _,_,err = s.build(...). Both totalBatchesIndexed and err are outer variables shared by all goroutines with no atomic/mutex and no shadowing. This is a data race, corrupts the indexed count in the trace event and can clobber errors. Use local variables and atomic counter.

findings.title: Stop mutates initErr without synchronization
findings.body: server in server.go guards initialization with sync.Once and initErr, but Stop unconditionally assigns s.initErr. Concurrent Init (or NewResourceServer init) and Stop access initErr without a mutex, causing a data race. Stop also poisons future Init calls to return 'service is stopped' even if startup already succeeded. Guard initErr with mutex/atomic.

findings.title: History/Origin panic when search is not configured
findings.body: Search in server.go checks s.search == nil, but History and Origin directly dereference s.search.History/Origin. When SearchOptions.Resources is nil, s.search is nil and those RPCs panic with nil dereference. Add the same nil guard as Search.

findings.title: New postgres skip hides storage-server failure
findings.body: module_server_test.go adds an unconditional skip for postgres for the storage-server instrumentation test. This reduces coverage for the exact backend this PR touches (unified storage init/startup) and can hide the regression the PR is fixing. Fix or track the test instead of skipping.
